capabilities: Open files and links in modal windows via drag-and-drop, right-click menu, or alt+click
Edit files inside modal windows and auto-embed a link at the cursor afterward
Jump to Markdown headings and block anchors within modals
Add custom commands and hotkeys to open chosen files or links
Restore a modal back to a normal tab by double-clicking its border
extras: Some features only work with modified versions of other plugins (obsidian-diagrams-net for diagram creation, vscode-editor for alt+click code block editing); the README links out to separate English and Chinese docs.
intentEvidence: The basic structure of this plugin is mainly based on obidian link opener.
problem: Obsidian opens files and links in tabs or split panes, which can clutter the workspace and interrupt reading or editing flow.
